cues: Periderm is phellogen plus phellem plus phelloderm.
Bark is everything outside the vascular cambium.
Write them in exactly those words, and never call the cork alone the bark.
text: Exam tip. Two definitions examiners love. Periderm is phellogen plus phellem plus phelloderm. Bark is everything outside the vascular cambium. Write them in exactly those words, and never call the cork alone the bark.
